targets.relevance_reason: Requirement.__eq__ (223–233) requires matching package name AND build flag before trait/reference conditions can make requirements equal; neighboring __hash__ (220–221) hashes the same (name, build) identity. A host and a build requirement are therefore not merged merely because their package name matches.

Requirement.aggregate (235–265) asserts equal build flags and merges headers/libs/run/visibility/directness and required_nodes. Node.propagate_downstream (graph.py:116–146) finds an existing transitive requirement, calls aggregate, then replaces its dictionary entry. This directly explains deduplication within a context while retaining traits.
